notes.subject: ⟨yu yet⟩
notes.rationale: לך (long yu) + sufiks — KJV tradisen: 'yu karamapim yu yet wantaim klaut'

notes.subject: סכותה (3:43) na סכותה (3:44)
notes.rationale: Wanpela rod סכך i kamap tupela taim klostu — karamap wantaim kros, karamap wantaim klaut; repitisen i no lus long Tok Pisin

notes.subject: yu karamapim mipela wantaim klaut
notes.rationale: סכותה i no gat objekt klia; sampela i ritim 'yu karamapim mipela' olsem v.43, tasol 'yu yet wantaim klaut' em i pasin bilong ol ritim moa

translation: Yu karamapim ⟨yu yet⟩ wantaim klaut, bilong pasim; praia i no inap pas i go.

tokens.gloss: bilong pasim; i no inap pas i go
